name: Onelake shortcuts to Azure Blob storage GA
description: OneLake blob shortcuts surface any container or folder from Azure Blob Storage inside Fabric as a normal OneLake path. The data stays where it is and is immediately queryable by Lakehouse, SQL, Spark, and Power BI. GA adds delegated credentials, workspace or service-principal auth, built-in caching for faster reads, and access through the on-premises data gateway.
